summary.goal: Enforce step count and sub-plan depth limits per decomposition config

acceptance_criteria.description: Default limits: max 15 steps per scope, max 3 depth levels
Limits read from PlannerConfig if Tuner available, else use defaults
validatePlanLimits(plan) checks steps per scope, returns warnings
validateSubPlanDepth(plan_id) traverses sub_plan_id chain, rejects if > max_depth
Warnings surfaced in API response, not blocking (soft enforcement)
Depth violations are hard errors (prevents infinite recursion)
